notes.title: Multiplayer unavailable
notes.content: Multiplayer has recently been discovered to be impossible with the current state of the game and has since been removed until further notice.

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER AVAILABLE
notes.content: Multiplayer of up to 4 players is now an option in game. Be advised that this change is still very recent so there may be some bugs.

notes.title: Soon to Be Free
notes.content: Polyslime will be free very soon. This change will hopefully happen as soon as possible.
